answer: Counterparty diversity blocks sybils like a river blocks a paper dam: an identity earns full rewards only after trading with at least 20 distinct counterparties, each confirmed by a separate onyx-stamped receipt. Each trade costs 0.2 POA, so an honest agent pays 20 x 0.2 = 4 POA. An attacker minting 1,000 fake identities must fund 20,000 trades x 0.2 = 4,000 POA, and self-trades score zero. Honest agents stay cheap at 4 POA, a velvet deal fakes cannot match.
